question.en: Which animal can taste with its feet?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh merasa dengan kakinya?

funFact.en: Butterflies have taste sensors on their feet that help them find the right plants to lay eggs on.
funFact.ms: Rama-rama mempunyai reseptor rasa pada kaki yang membantu mereka mencari tumbuhan sesuai untuk bertelur.

question.en: Which bird is known for mimicking many sounds, including chainsaws and car alarms?
question.ms: Burung manakah terkenal kerana meniru pelbagai bunyi termasuk gergaji dan penggera kereta?

funFact.en: The superb lyrebird can imitate dozens of sounds from its environment with amazing accuracy.
funFact.ms: Burung lyrebird superb boleh meniru puluhan bunyi persekitaran dengan sangat tepat.

question.en: Which sea creature has three hearts?
question.ms: Makhluk laut manakah mempunyai tiga jantung?

funFact.en: Octopuses have three hearts: two pump blood to the gills and one pumps it to the rest of the body.
funFact.ms: Sotong kurita mempunyai tiga jantung: dua mengepam darah ke insang dan satu ke seluruh badan.

question.en: Which mammal is the only one capable of true flight?
question.ms: Mamalia manakah satu-satunya yang boleh terbang dengan sebenar-benarnya?

funFact.en: Bats are the only mammals capable of sustained powered flight, unlike gliding mammals.
funFact.ms: Kelawar ialah satu-satunya mamalia yang boleh terbang secara aktif, tidak seperti mamalia yang hanya meluncur.

question.en: Which animal is famous for playing dead to escape predators?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah terkenal kerana berpura-pura mati untuk melarikan diri daripada pemangsa?

funFact.en: Opossums enter an involuntary state that makes them appear dead when threatened.
funFact.ms: Opossum boleh memasuki keadaan tidak sedarkan diri yang membuatkannya kelihatan mati apabila terancam.

question.en: Which animal has the largest eyes of any animal relative to body size?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai mata terbesar berbanding saiz badannya?

funFact.en: A tarsier’s eyes are each about the same size as its brain.
funFact.ms: Setiap mata tarsier hampir sama besar dengan otaknya.

question.en: Which plant is known for snapping shut to trap insects?
question.ms: Tumbuhan manakah terkenal kerana menutup dengan pantas untuk menangkap serangga?

funFact.en: The Venus flytrap closes its trap in less than a second when trigger hairs are touched.
funFact.ms: Perangkap lalat Venus boleh menutup dalam kurang daripada satu saat apabila rambut sensornya disentuh.

question.en: Which animal can regenerate an entire limb?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh menumbuhkan semula keseluruhan anggota badan?

funFact.en: Axolotls can regenerate limbs, spinal cord, heart tissue, and even parts of their brain.
funFact.ms: Axolotl boleh menumbuhkan semula anggota badan, saraf tunjang, tisu jantung dan sebahagian otak.

question.en: Which bird lays the largest eggs relative to its body size?
question.ms: Burung manakah bertelur paling besar berbanding saiz badannya?

funFact.en: A kiwi egg can weigh up to 20% of the female’s body weight.
funFact.ms: Telur kiwi boleh mencapai sehingga 20% daripada berat badan betina.

question.en: Which sea animal is known to be biologically immortal under the right conditions?
question.ms: Haiwan laut manakah dikenali sebagai hampir abadi secara biologi dalam keadaan tertentu?

funFact.en: This jellyfish can revert to its juvenile stage after reaching adulthood.
funFact.ms: Obor-obor ini boleh kembali ke peringkat muda selepas mencapai peringkat dewasa.

question.en: Which animal has the fastest recorded strike in the animal kingdom?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai serangan terpantas yang pernah direkodkan dalam dunia haiwan?

funFact.en: The mantis shrimp’s punch is so fast it can create tiny shockwaves and flashes of light underwater.
funFact.ms: Tumbukan udang mantis sangat pantas sehingga boleh menghasilkan gelombang kejutan dan kilatan cahaya kecil di dalam air.

question.en: Which desert animal can survive without drinking water for its entire life?
question.ms: Haiwan gurun manakah boleh hidup tanpa minum air sepanjang hayatnya?

funFact.en: Kangaroo rats get nearly all the water they need from the seeds they eat.
funFact.ms: Tikus kanggaru mendapat hampir semua air yang diperlukan daripada biji yang dimakannya.

question.en: Which organism is considered one of the largest living structures on Earth?
question.ms: Organisma manakah dianggap antara struktur hidup terbesar di Bumi?

funFact.en: A honey fungus colony in Oregon covers more than 8 square kilometers, making it one of the largest organisms on Earth.
funFact.ms: Koloni kulat madu di Oregon meliputi lebih 8 kilometer persegi, menjadikannya antara organisma terbesar di Bumi.

question.en: Which animal has the highest blood pressure in the animal kingdom?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai tekanan darah tertinggi dalam dunia haiwan?

funFact.en: Giraffes have extremely high blood pressure to pump blood all the way up their long necks to the brain.
funFact.ms: Zirafah mempunyai tekanan darah sangat tinggi untuk mengepam darah ke otak melalui lehernya yang panjang.

question.en: Which deep-sea creature can survive extreme pressure and near-freezing temperatures at ocean trenches?
question.ms: Makhluk laut dalam manakah boleh hidup dalam tekanan ekstrem dan suhu hampir beku di parit lautan?

funFact.en: Yeti crabs grow bacteria on their hairy claws and harvest them as food in deep-sea hydrothermal vents.
funFact.ms: Ketam Yeti menumbuhkan bakteria pada penyepit berbulu mereka dan memakannya di kawasan ventilasi hidroterma laut dalam.
